newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian troops to leave Albania at end-July.
newsitem.headline: Austrian troops to leave Albania at end-July.

text.p: Austria will begin withdrawing some 100 troops from a multinational security force in Albania at the end of July, the defence ministry said on Friday.
"It is planned that the Austrian Albania contingent will be relocated home in the last third of July," the statement said.
The ministry said the Austrian soldiers would start returning about four to five days after the Italian-led 7,000-strong international force officially pulls out on July 20.

The Austrian government two weeks ago extended the mandate of their troops in Albania until mid-August to help stabilise the chaotic Balkan state after the second round of a hard-fought general election on Sunday.
Italy earlier on Friday said it would begin withdrawing its own troops on July 18.

The force's main brief was to guard aid convoys to the violence-stricken country. More than 1,500 people have died in months of unrest sparked by the collapse of shady investment schemes earlier this year.
